crossRefs.note: Listen to the voice of my cry, my King and my God; for I pray to you.
Yahweh, in the morning you will hear my voice. In the morning I will lay my requests before you, and will watch…
To you, Yahweh, I call. My rock, don’t be deaf to me, lest, if you are silent to me, I would become like those who go…
Hear the voice of my petitions, when I cry to you, when I lift up my hands toward your Most Holy Place.
As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
Trust in him at all times, you people. Pour out your heart before him. God is a refuge for us.
I call on Yahweh, who is worthy to be praised; So shall I be saved from my enemies.
In nothing be anxious, but in everything, by prayer and petition with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to…
And the peace of God, which surpasses all understanding, will guard your hearts and your thoughts in Christ Jesus.
Praise waits for you, God, in Zion. Vows shall be performed to you.
You who hear prayer, all men will come to you.
Glorious are you, and excellent, more than mountains of game.
Then the Levites, Jeshua, and Kadmiel, Bani, Hashabneiah, Sherebiah, Hodiah, Shebaniah, and Pethahiah, said, “Stand up…
“Worthy are you, our Lord and God, the Holy One, to receive the glory, the honor, and the power, for you created all…
saying with a loud voice, “Worthy is the Lamb who has been killed to receive the power, wealth, wisdom, strength…
Call on me in the day of trouble. I will deliver you, and you will honor me.”
He will call on me, and I will answer him. I will be with him in trouble. I will deliver him, and honor him.
salvation from our enemies and from the hand of all who hate us;
It will be that whoever will call on the name of the Lord will be saved.’
What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?
